sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Am/C]We’ll build on [G/D]the Rock, the living Rock,

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [G]We'll build on the Rock, on the solid Rock,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [Am/C]Some build on [G/D]the sinking sands of life,
[D]Some build on the waves [G]of sin and strife,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [Am/C]O build on [G/D]the Rock, for ever sure,
[D]Its hope is the hope [G]which shall endure,
